methods.name: RMAU-NET
methods.summary: RMAU-NET is a deep-learning-based architecture for landslide detection and segmentation. It utilizes a U-Net backbone enhanced with residual-convolutional layers, multi-head attention mechanisms, and multiple resolution heads, trained using a combined Focal and IoU loss function on multi-spectral and derived input features.
methods.source: Lam Pham, Cam Le, Hieu Tang, Khang Truong, Truong Nguyen, Jasmin Lampert, Alexander Schindler, Son Phan
